segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT
segments.narration: OpenAI launched Businesses in ChatGPT in beta on November tenth, twenty twenty-six.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Claim a profile, publish a Business Agent
segments.narration: Eligible U.S. online businesses publish an agent built from their product feed. A dashboard tracks mentions and clicks.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: Free at launch, but there are catches
segments.narration: It's free at launch, but OpenAI hasn't ruled out charging. Claiming a profile doesn't guarantee better placement.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Claim it, fill it in, test it
segments.narration: Our take: claim your profile, fill it in carefully, and treat results as a test.
